name: Plan steps linked to issues with derived progress
description:
plan entries carry steps[] with title + issue numbers. Feature is recorded only in docs; issues get no feature field.
docs show renders progress from .repo-issues via core (done/total, per-step state, blocked markers). Progress is derived, never stored.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Merged 478beda. YAML: plan entries take steps: [{ title, issues: [n, ...] }]; only plan entries may have steps (StepsOnNonPlan, InvalidStep validator rules). Core: RepoCli.Core/Features/IssueLinks/IssueIndex.Load(root) is a tolerant read-only issue reader (number, name, state, blockedBy). Progress: PlanProgress.For(entry, index); Done counts Done plus Cancelled; a missing issue counts toward the total but is never done; step states are done/in-progress/blocked/open; PlanRenderer.Write draws a Spectre tree. For #33: the docs YAML model lives in RepoDocsCli and Core has no YamlDotNet, so rewriting steps on renumber needs either a small steps reader/writer in Core or moving part of the model.
